info.title: Domovoi hub API
info.description: The hub's JSON API. Log in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session is a cookie. Send the session's `csrf_token` as `X-CSRF-Token` on every unsafe request.

post.summary:
Asks a question. The question and a pending answer are committed together and the call
answers at once; the answer is written in the background and arrives as a journal event,
preceded by `live.*` events on the event stream. Sending the same `turn` again returns the
stored pair and asks the model nothing.

400.description: The operation id is not a uuid

get.summary: Committed journal rows as server-sent events.
get.description:
Frames: `ready` (`head_seq`, `resumed`, `topics`), `journal` (one row; its `id` is the journal
`seq`), `reset` (`reason` is `pruned`, `ahead` or `lagged`: refetch what you hold). A client
that reconnects sends `Last-Event-ID` (or `after`) and receives every matching row after it.
An idle stream sends a `: keepalive` comment every 15 seconds.

A connection that follows `conversations:<uuid>` also receives the ephemeral `live.start`,
`live.text`, `live.tool` and `live.end` events of an answer being written. They carry no `id`,
are never replayed and may be dropped when a client is slow; the committed message arrives as
a `journal` frame.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description:
Comma-separated topics: `incidents`, `approvals`, `operations`, `operation:<id>`,
`hosts`, `conversations:<id>`. At most 16. Absent means `incidents,approvals,operations`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume after this journal `seq`. The `Last-Event-ID` header wins when both are given.

400.description: An unknown topic or a malformed position

503.description: Too many open event streams

parameters.description:

in `needs_action` otherwise; `handled` is acknowledged or muted.

post.summary: Acknowledges an incident.

post.summary:
Asks the triage model a follow-up question about an incident. It uses read-only tools
and never proposes actions.

400.description: Empty or too long

429.description: The hourly model limit is reached; Retry-After says when to come back

503.description: Triage is off or the model is unavailable

post.summary:
Dismisses an incident as a known condition: closes it now with the verdict `EXPECTED`,
and when `ignore_for_minutes` is given, creates the rule that keeps the check quiet
(0 means always). The rule is stored before the incident closes, so a check firing in
the moment between the two is already silenced, and a dismiss that fails afterwards
leaves a rule that a human can see and delete on the Known conditions page. The rule
matches the incident's host, check and target; `note` is the reason, so a human can
read later what it covers. A target with `*` in it cannot be matched exactly by a rule
pattern, so dismissing such an incident with a period is refused.

400.description: Empty reason, too long, too many minutes, or a target a rule cannot match

409.description: Not possible now

get.summary:

post.summary:
Forgets the conversation: the next question will not be shown the earlier ones. Works
whether triage is on or off, and on a resolved incident too; it writes one timeline

Imports a signed package: the archive and its detached signature file as one multipart

opens the archive. No password is asked for: importing installs nothing.

AckRuleDto.description: A known condition: incidents that match it stay in the history and never notify.

check.description: The check the rule matches, for example `security.ssh_login`.

created_at.description: When the rule was created; null for rules made before this was recorded.

created_by.description: The username of the person who created the rule; null when unknown.

expires_at.description: When the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description:
The host the rule is limited to, by name; null means every host. A host missing
from the store shows as `unknown host` with its id, so the list still works.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null means any target.

check.description: The check to match, for example `security.ssh_login`.

expires_at.description:
The exact time the rule stops applying, as RFC 3339, such as `2026-12-01T10:00:00Z`.
When present it is used instead of `expires_in_minutes`, so a rule can be restored
with its original expiry; an unparseable value is refused.

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description: Host by name; null matches every host.

note.description: Why the condition is acceptable, 1 to 500 characters.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold; at most 10.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null matches any target.

AckRulePatch.description: The fields of a known condition that can change. Anything left out stays as it is.

expires_at.description: The exact time the rule stops applying, as RFC 3339; null means it never expires.

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the rule stops applying. Ignored when `expires_at` is given.

host.description: Host by name; null makes the rule apply to every host.

note.description: Why the condition is acceptable, 1 to 500 characters.

predicates.description: Replaces the conditions on the evidence; at most 10.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null matches any target.

host_id.description: The host it is about, if any.

AnswerStepRequest.description: Answering the question an operation waits on.

text.description: The answer, 1 to 2000 characters after trimming. It reaches the model as data.

confirm_text.description: Required when the execution says `confirm_required`: the skill's name typed exactly.

password.description: A containment step only: the signed-in person's password, asked again.

plan_hash.description: Required. The v2 plan hash shown on the execution, 64 hex characters.

unverified_acknowledged.description:
A containment step only: set when the person acknowledges that the helper's coverage
could not be verified. Without it that step is refused with `unverified_not_acknowledged`.

AskResponse.description: The answer to a follow-up question.

checked_at.description: When the hub last recorded an outcome or asked.

helper_reason.description: The token of a validly signed incomplete report. Display only.

oneOf.description: Why it is not verified, when it is not.

unsigned_hint.description: The unsigned token an agent relayed. Unverified: the agent can invent it.

AuditAnchorDto.description: The anchor the chain starts from.

install_id.description: The install this log belongs to.

AuditPageDto.description: One page of audit entries, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last.

AuditRowDto.description: One audit entry with its chain position.

detail.description: The entry's detail as compact JSON text, secrets removed, cut at 4096 bytes.

hash.description: The entry's hash as 64 lower-case hex characters; `null` if the entry lost it.

kind.description: What kind of entry it is.

AuditVerificationDto.description: The result of checking the audit log.

anchor.description: The anchor the chain is judged against.

oneOf.description: The newest stored entry; `null` before the first entry.

draft: the preview to save over it. The two hashes differ, so publish needs the `null` one.

ProfileDto.description: What the hub knows about one machine, as its agent reported it.

markdown.description: The note text: the summary, then every tool output.

note.description: The generated note carrying this profile, so the UI can link to it.

sections.description: One entry per tool output, in the order the tools ran.

ProfileSectionDto.description: One tool output in a host profile: its title and whether it answered.

ok.description: Whether the tool answered; a failed one shows in the profile as a gap.

title.description: What the tool was asked for, for example `Containers`.

acknowledged.description: Exactly the keys of the blocking findings.

preview_hash.description: The `preview_hash` of the draft's rules against the active version.

locked_changes.description: Locked prohibitions that differ from the version it replaces.

failing.description: The names of the checks that failed, in a fixed order; empty when ready.

ReceivedKeyDto.description: A key the helper's session relayed, with the fingerprint the hub computed.

fingerprint_groups.description: The same, in groups of four, as `domovoi helper fingerprint` prints it.

key_id.description: The first 16 characters of the fingerprint: a label, never trusted.

content_purged.description: Whether the retention purge cleared its endpoints.

from.description: The source end; `null` once the retention purge cleared it.

observed_at.description: When it was last seen to hold.

stored_status.description: The status stored in the row.

to.description: The target end; `null` once the retention purge cleared it.

version.description: The version a later change must name.

evidence.description: What it was derived from, as `<kind>:<id>`.

from.description: The source end, a subject reference.

to.description: The target end, a subject reference.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last.

confirm_source.description: The block's canonical source, typed exactly.

baseline.description: What the row recorded, when it could be read: a decision, or `{ "error": "<code>" }`.

simulated.description: What the rules decide now: a decision, or `{ "error": "<code>" }`.

headline.description: What is wrong, in one line.

manual_steps.description: Steps a person does by hand, in order.

ResolutionBriefDto.description: The outcome of a finished operation, for a list row.

ResolutionSummaryDto.description: The summary of one operation with where each field came from.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position read before the summary; apply only events with a greater `seq`.

fields.description: The current revision of each field that has one.

history.description: Every revision, oldest first; the newest 200 when there are more.

history_truncated.description: Whether older revisions were left out of `history`.

state.description:
`not_ready` while the operation is open, `drafting` once it has finished and has no
summary yet, `ready` after.

note.description: What the owner checked, 1 to 280 characters.

extend.description: Limits to raise first, at most 7, each kind once. A spent limit must be raised.

applies.description: `now` when the period is applied, `later` when it is declared but not applied yet.

applies_once.description: What the period waits for, when `applies` is `later`.

days.description: The value in force, in days.

RetentionSettings.description: The retention periods in force and how many backups are kept.

entries.description: The nine `[retention]` periods, in registry order.

password.description: The owner's password, asked for again.

plan_hash.description: The host's `plan_hash` from the plan the owner confirmed.

revoked.description: `false` when the host had no live agent.

RevokeRequest.description: The body of a revoke: the host's name typed again, as the web page asks for.

confirm.description: Must equal the host name in the path.

RuleDto.description: One policy rule as the editor reads and writes it.

conditions.description: Conditions that decide whether the rule matches.

locked.description: A locked rule is an absolute prohibition; only a `deny` can be locked.

note.description: Owner text for the editor and the trace.

shadow.description: A shadow rule is evaluated and recorded, never enforced.

oneOf.description: The stored draft.
A published version.
Rules sent with the request.

base_revision.description: `null` creates the draft; a revision replaces that revision.

password.description: The admin's password; needed only when a locked prohibition changes.

preview_hash.description: The `preview_hash` of exactly these rules; needed only when a locked prohibition changes.

applied.description: Whether the hub restarted with the change.

ScopeDto.description: What a conversation is about, as shown.

host_name.description: The host's name; `null` when the host is gone.

ScopeRequest.description: What a conversation is about, chosen when it is created.

turn.description: A client-generated uuid: sending it again changes nothing.

SendResponse.description: The committed question and its answer.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position after the commit.

assistant.description: The answer: pending, or its current state for a repeated send.

operation_id.description: The operation to attach, or `null` to detach.

oneOf.description: Discord, if configured.

Everything the settings page edits; `None` when the hub runs from a fixed
configuration and settings are read-only.
The primary model provider, if configured.
The fallback model provider, if configured.

retention.description: The retention periods in force and the backup counts.

base_revision.description: The revision the change was made on; a stale one answers 409.

changes.description:
The changes, shaped like `hub.toml`. `null` removes a value so the lower layers
apply. A secret takes `{ "keep": true }`, `{ "set": "…" }` or `{ "clear": true }`.

password.description:
The admin's password, needed when the change touches chat approvers, trusted
proxies, webhooks or any secret.

SetupRequest.description: Creating the admin account on first run.

token.description: The token from the setup link the hub logged.

username.description: Login name, 1 to 64 characters without spaces.

enforced.description: The enforced-rules decision: a decision, or `{ "error": "<code>" }`.

gaps.description: The inputs that were unavailable and why.

inputs.description: The exact inputs the evaluator was given; none unless the row is `evaluated`.

ShadowDetailDto.description: One recorded decision with everything needed to replay it.

ShadowFilterDto.description: Which recorded rows a simulation takes.

differing.description: Only rows whose enforced and shadow outcomes differ.

since.description: Only rows recorded at or after this instant, RFC 3339.

until.description: Only rows recorded before this instant, RFC 3339.

ShadowPageDto.description: A page of recorded decisions, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

last_error.description: Why the last sweep failed, if it did.

total_unevaluable.description: Steps whose inputs could not be established, ever.

ShadowSummaryRowDto.description: One recorded decision in a list.

policy_version.description: The policy version it was recorded under; 0 when none was published.

reason.description: Why it is not evaluated, or `late`.

score.description: The score; higher is more similar.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position read before the list.

SimilarReasonDto.description: Why a past operation was judged similar.

SimulateRequest.description: Simulate rules over recorded Execution steps.

execution_ids.description: Explicit steps instead of a filter; at most 100.

label.description: Which rules were simulated, in words.

truncated.description: Whether more rows matched than were taken.

degraded.description: Whether some input was unavailable when it was recorded.

oneOf.description: The enforced-rules decision, when asked for.

gaps.description: The inputs that were unavailable and why.

recorded_policy_version.description: The policy version it was recorded under; 0 when none was published.

oneOf.description: The shadow-rules decision, when asked for.

not_replayable.description: Rows that could not be replayed.

same.description: Rows whose decision did not change.

enabled.description: Whether the hub may run and suggest this skill on the host.

manifest_hash.description: Hash of the full manifest the agent has, as hex.

readme.description: The skill folder's README.md, at most 8 KiB; absent when there is none.

timeout_secs.description: How long one run may take, in seconds.

oneOf.description: How the hub verifies a write skill, when it declares one.

enabled.description: Whether the hub may run and suggest the skill on this host.

oneOf.description: A containment step only: its phase, source, TTL and how the helper's safety stood.

output.description: What it produced, redacted and at most 16 KiB.

phase.description: A short label of the phase of work.

reason.description: Why it ended as it did.

summary.description: One line on what it came to.

SummaryFieldDto.description: The current revision of one summary field.

editable.description: Whether the owner can edit it: a narrative field of a finished operation.

value.description: The canonical JSON of the revision: a string, a boolean or an array.

SummaryRevisionDto.description: One revision in a field's history.

since.description: When the earliest counted failure settled.

TargetFailureDto.description: Why a host's target did not succeed.

code.description: A stable code such as `transfer_failed` or `signature_invalid`.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

oneOf.description: Every target.

changes.description: The same shape as a save; a secret left as `{ "keep": true }` uses the stored one.

latency_ms.description: How long it took, in milliseconds.

calls.description: How many times it was called.

to.description: The earlier step it points at.

oneOf.description: Why it is paused, when it is.

kind.description: What it points at, for example `execution`.

summary.description: One line on what it came to.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed.

at.description: When the answer was recorded, RFC 3339.

UnpinKeyRequest.description: The owner's request to unpin the helper key.

password.description: The account password, asked for again.
